method: On the first 1000000 search nodes of the frozen fixed task, evaluate every gap-bearing lag at every exact check, record the complete failing-lag mask, then greedily choose the lag covering the largest remaining weighted set of failing masks. The order only changes conjunction evaluation order and is not part of correctness.
scope: Profile-guided scheduling heuristic for lags 1..34. Every active lag is still checked unless an earlier exact failure returns; startup validation rejects an incomplete priority list.
